clips.title: The story
paras: At Steelgrill's Depot near Kharanos, Pilot Bellowfiz needs a potent brew from Brewnall Village. Rejold Barleybrew's Evershine can warm a traveler or fuel Bellowfiz's siege engine.

Rejold Barleybrew brews Evershine in Brewnall Village, where his experiments push past ordinary dwarven brewing. The drink is strong enough to knock all but the hardiest dwarves flat. In Dun Morogh's bitter cold, its heat makes it prized despite its force.

Pilot Bellowfiz works from Steelgrill's Depot outside Kharanos, where Evershine serves two purposes. A nip helps him endure the freezing winds, and the volatile alcohol can fuel his siege engine, Jetsteam. Poured into its furnace, the brew gives the engine an explosive surge of emergency power when Bellowfiz is in a tight spot.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Rejold Barleybrew experiments with his brews. Some of them taste good, some bad, and some...well, some will lay all but the stoutest traveler flat.
He lives at Brewnall Village, west of Kharanos, and one of his drinks, Evershine, is what I want. It'll help keep me warm while I'm on the cold road.
And...the blessed stuff burns so hot I can throw it in Jetsteam's furnace for a burst of power! That little tactic has gotten me out of more than one tight spot.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Bellowfiz needs some of my Evershine? Hm...all right.
